_leewayHeader.layer: Agent Lee Capability / Private Interview Proctor
_leewayHeader.purpose: Control answer withholding, scoring, remediation, and receipt behavior for private interview assessments.
_leewayHeader.inputs: Authenticated learner, assessment manifest, submitted answers, private answer key, and scoring rubric.
_leewayHeader.outputs: Score, category feedback, remediation, and private receipt.
_leewayHeader.tests: JSON parse, default deny, answer withholding, and architecture tests.
_leewayHeader.securityImpact: Prevents answer-key leakage to commercial or unauthorized learners.
